frontier_selector.why: The evidence of acute speech disturbance, right-sided weakness, and CT angiography revealing acute occlusion of the left middle cerebral artery at M1/M2 decided it.

support_spans: presented with acute speech disturbance and right-sided weakness
global aphasia, right facial asymmetry, right upper- and lower-limb paresis with decreased tone, and a right Babinski sign
CT angiography revealed acute occlusion of the left middle cerebral artery at M1/M2 and chronic occlusion of the left internal carotid artery
severe low-gradient aortic stenosis with preserved ejection fraction
pulmonary emboli in segmental arteries of the right lower lobe
chronic occlusion of the left internal carotid artery
an incidental mass in the left orbit was also noted
